programme.desc: Get ready for a not-so-quiet night in Oddsville! When a power cut strikes, all the Oddbods seek refuge at Fuse's house, ruining his plans to watch the big game. Then, a funky asteroid lands in the cul-de-sac and emits groovy pop music that puts everyone in a dance trance! The chaos continues when one of Newt's eggs gets zapped at the store and hatches into an adorable but monstrously hungry chick!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are making new friends and foes! First, Zee inadvertently picks up a piglet from a nearby farm and quickly forms a strong bond with his new friend. Then, Slick, with a little help from Bubbles, enters a 'Robot Wars' tournament! As he progresses through the rounds, his arrogance makes him an unlikely winner. Finally, Jeff discovers some unwanted nesting birds in his garden and a battle of wits begins!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Join Blippi for some fun nature discoveries! First, he and D.BO dive to the ocean floor to help a forgetful island remember why it doesn't float away. Then, they shrink down for some smaller adventures! They help a firefly find a friend with the same blinking pattern, float high in the sky to learn how bubbles are made and join a group of ants on a mission to find out how they walk in such a straight line. The adventure is full of singing, science and new friends!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is learning fun facts all about the world! He and D.BO shrink down to meet Ernie the Eraser, an aspiring magician who teaches them the science behind how erasers work. Then, they fly into the night sky to learn how fireworks get their colors and why some animals, like raccoons, prefer to come out at night. The adventure continues as Blippi learns how to be a cowboy in the desert and helps a brave spoon protect his cereal from getting soggy!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is on an adventure from dinosaurs to pet knights! He travels back in time with Tabbs to help a little Microraptor prove that being small has its benefits when they rescue a giant sauropod from the mud. Then, they head to the African savannah to learn how to roar, sneak and pounce like a lion! Back at the clubhouse, Blippi learns how to interpret a puppy's tail wags and even travels back in time again to help a real-life knight in shining armor-who happens to be a corgi!

programme.title: Supa Strikas

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi for a fun-filled day of color play! His adventure begins at Ball N Bounce kids playhouse, where he plays lots of colorful games. He challenges himself on the rock wall, plays in colorful sand and finds the best ball for a game of soccer! Then, Blippi enjoys a day of playtime at Billy Beez, where he learns about the colors of the rainbow while sliding down the amazing rainbow slides!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi's day is full of innovation and creation at the MOXI, the Wolf Museum of Exploration and Innovation! He explores fascinating exhibits on sound, light and technology even making his own creation. He zooms around playing with magnets, tests his jumping skills, checks speed on a topsy-turvy race track and finishes with a splash demonstrating what innovation is all about!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is wondering, 'How does it work?!' Join Blippi and his robot buddy FETCH on an adventure to find the answers! Blippi shrinks down to fly inside a beehive and learn how honey is made, and explores a garbage truck to find out why flies love it so much. Then, it's a trip through a factory to see how chocolate is made! The adventure even travels through time as Blippi meets his great-grandpa to see the very first cars. Plus, Blippi and FETCH help a nervous crane learn to build a skyscraper!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is wondering about animals on an ultimate adventure! Join Blippi and his robot friend FETCH as they travel the world to get their questions answered. How high can a kangaroo jump? Blippi finds out in a hopping race in Australia! How do bats see in the dark? A new bat friend shows him all about echolocation! The adventure continues as he learns why squirrels bury nuts and how ducks float. Blippi and FETCH also help their new friends, like when they work together to rebuild a blue jay's nest!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is learning awesome facts about all kinds of animals! He and D.BO travel back in time to meet the biggest dinosaurs, like the Argentinosaurus, and even try to keep a T-Rex as a pet for a day! Back in the present, they shrink down to count a shark's teeth with a pilot fish dentist. The adventure continues as Blippi learns how elephants use their trunks to keep cool and discovers why cats have whiskers from a local feline celebrity.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some new problems! Zee is zapped by an impatient Bubbles who is tired of his sluggishness. He soon finds himself sped up, but with some unintended side effects! Then, Fuse discovers his long-lost teddy bear, Mr. Snuffles, but as soon as he is found, he is lost again! Fuse goes to extreme lengths to find his bear. Finally, Fuse accidentally breaks Bubbles' totem pole and tries to cover it up.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some new obsessions! Jeff is convinced that Pogo is responsible for the theft of a bale of straw from his garden, but no one believes him. Jeff begins an obsessive quest to clear his name and prove that Pogo is behind it all! Then, feeling emasculated, Jeff seeks Fuse's help to teach him to be stronger and more macho. But it's not long before his new macho-ness becomes a problem.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: A strange ray accidentally zaps Hye and Lo, making them so brilliant that they defy Adilla and begin using their new intellect to help the Insectibles create peace. Their efforts are complicated when Zak mistakes their help for an attack. At the same time, Gramps invents a helmet camera to offer technical support on missions, but his constant stream of advice becomes more of a hindrance than a help, creating chaos from two different sources.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: Lidia discovers a remote that can control Willow's bionic drill, but Adilla quickly snatches it, gaining mind-control over the Insectibles' friend. Before she can use this new power to her advantage, a new crisis emerges. The roaches find a magic 8-ball and declare it their new leader, and its first comm and is to destroy the Shrinkinator. Adilla must now team up with her arch-enemy Zak to save the very machine she has been trying to steal.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: The moment of triumph is here as Gramps and Zak find the final piece of the Shrinkinator! But their celebration is cut short when Adilla captures the entire team. After a daring escape, the Insectibles brace for a final showdown. While Syd rallies the other bugs in the yard for support, Zak, Willow, and Chowser mount a desperate defense of the shed, with Zak facing Adilla one last time to stop her from activating the Shrinkinator and claiming victory.

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Spring has sprung, and so have the Antiks! Join them as they explore a world of blossoming flowers and fresh spring treats. From climbing giant mushrooms to navigating through a garden of delights, their adventures are as colorful as the season. It's a story about discovery, teamwork, and enjoying the sweet tastes of spring.

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: When a delicious berry is in peril, the Antiks spring into action! Join them on a heroic rescue mission to save the tasty treat from a terrible fate. They'll have to be brave, work together, and overcome some big challenges to bring the berry safely back home. It's an exciting adventure that shows even the smallest heroes can make a big difference.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi has a spectacular Southern California visit! He plays outside at the Children's Hands-On Museum, making mud pies and learning to count and ride a tricycle while exploring the grounds. Then, it's all aboard for a train-tastic journey where he rides the rails and discovers what makes trains such an amazing way to travel.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi as he learns about tasty dishes and healthy habits! First, he heads to King's Roost to learn all about how flour is made. He explores a mill and even makes some giant pancakes with an expert! Then, it's time to learn a healthy habit. Blippi visits the dentist and learns how fun a checkup can be! He meets Dr. Ray, who teaches him how to properly brush, floss and count his teeth.

Saksikan sebuah drama menarik lakonan Beto Khusairy, Diana Danielle, Hasnul Rahmat dan Wan Maimunah.
